risk_scoring_model.scoring_notes: Scores are based on qualitative assessment of each dimension for the given test case.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Successful login with valid credentials redirects to dashboard
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Standard happy‑path login; failure would affect few users and has low security exposure.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Password field masks input characters
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: UI cosmetic issue; minimal impact on business or security.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Invalid credentials display generic error message
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Incorrect handling could expose authentication logic; moderate likelihood.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Non‑existent email triggers generic error message
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Potential user enumeration risk; important but mitigated by generic message.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Client‑side validation rejects malformed email format
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Minor UI validation; low impact if it fails.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Client‑side validation prevents empty password submission
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Missing validation could allow empty passwords leading to security concerns.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Brute‑force protection locks account after max failed attempts
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Critical security control; failure could enable account takeover.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Login response time under load meets performance SLA
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Performance degradation affects user experience and may breach SLA.
